evidence_excerpts: The psychedelic ceremony was associated with increases in scores of Fatalistic determinism at 4 weeks versus baseline (t(121) = 2.81, p = 0.012, d = 0.25, 95% CI [0.06, 0.37]); however, this effect did not persist at 6 months.
For psychedelic-naïve participants ... the changes persisted for at least 6 months (t(52) = 2.86, p = 0.012, d = 0.39, 95% CI [0.11, 0.64]).
text: Ceremonial psychedelic use increased fatalistic determinism at four weeks in the overall prospective sample, but this effect did not persist to six months except in the psychedelic-naive subgroup.
